dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Truly refined! May wealth find you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: Judging by your appearance... You must be a noble! Maybe one who's achieved extreme wealth a long time ago!

dialogues.speaker: Baishu
dialogues.text: If you ever decide to expand in Yilong Wharf, you can count on me to help with anything you may need!
